title: Big Bug
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about a boss that takes several hits. Big Bug sits in a narrow way and a star does not stop it: it takes five. In the first level nothing says how many are left, so you count. In the second its shell has five lights and one goes out with each hit. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how many hits it takes.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has a pocketful of gold stars and two short levels to cross. Big Bug, round, green and very cheerful, sits in a narrow way through a brick wall, and one star will not move it: it takes five. Read the signs, press Enter, count, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how many hits it takes.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A boss is a chain of monsters, one for each hit
Made to be copied and taken apart
